### Module(s)

mini.ai

### Question

Hiya,
With `mini.ai`, I'm not getting the behaviour I expect with paragraphs (`p` textobject).
Taking this file:
```
the first paragraph of text
the first paragraph of text
the first paragraph of text

the second paragraph
the second paragraph
the second paragraph

the third paragraph
the third paragraph
the third paragraph
```
With the cursor inside the second paragraph, `dinp` deletes the second paragraph, and from within the third paragraph `dalp` deletes the third paragraph, not the second. It seems to always operate on the covering or next paragraph (regardless of what `search_method` is used).

Why?

comment_data.body:
> Why?

Because `p` is not a [textobject id built into 'mini.ai'](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/0f339bf5c93f392dc5d2417d47d7b9edc5f96fe8/doc/mini-ai.txt#L138-L163). As [Latin characters do not fit for fallback textobject](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/0f339bf5c93f392dc5d2417d47d7b9edc5f96fe8/doc/mini-ai.txt#L173), they [fall back to the Neovim's built-in textobjects](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/0f339bf5c93f392dc5d2417d47d7b9edc5f96fe8/doc/mini-ai.txt#L41), for which search methods do not apply. Same for `w` (like `dinw`, `calw`), `W`, etc.

The reason for this is basically that in order for different search methods to work, textobject has to be implemented via 'mini.ai' specification. It sounds doable for paragraphs, but for others it is kind of convoluted to implement.
